quarterly_data.quarter: Hubei DOTI Micro Technology results briefing Q&A: 2025 annual (06-12-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Chairman Gao Denghua (2025 annual results briefing): Z-Block orders on hand are ample; Nanchang base capacity construction is on plan, and since the industry-wide capacity bottleneck is production equipment, the company planned equipment purchases ahead and tools are arriving as scheduled while capacity ramps. Rising high-speed module demand and rare-earth export controls have tightened supply of Faraday rotators, which the company buys and does not make; it has signed stable supply agreements with upstream suppliers, stocked raw materials ahead and is exploring diversified supply. Board secretary and CFO Li Guanghua said optical-communication filter orders are full, capacity ramp and deliveries proceed together, and filter prices may be adjusted with costs; on Faraday rotators he said production has not been hurt so far. In silicon photonics it mainly supplies silicon lenses and isolators.
